text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I've heard about "pulling out all the
stops," and
now I understand what it
means.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'll run turf, dirt—whatever it takes to
see my
Umas shining up close and
personal!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
If it's for my oshis, I'll gladly line up in
the
freezing cold to buy merch or get up
at the break
of dawn in the summer heat!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huehehe! No battleground is too
harrowing when
it comes to my Umas!
Facing hardship only makes
a hero
stronger!
